Generative Large Language Models (LLMs) are used by an increasing number of non-NLP experts for many diverse applications, such as code generation and creative writing, but also recommendation, planning, and advice.

The paper evaluates generated responses in multi-turn dialogues, including creative writing (e.g., story generation), recommendations, and advice, based on user demographic cues and stereotypical topics.
